model_output.score_comment_short: Recent bullets show substantial case support, though several leave the work unexplained.
model_output.score_comment_long: The current role names four partners, productions of up to 250,000 pages, and two jury trials. Other bullets list tasks without showing how you handled them. Adding a few concrete examples would make the work easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: Your resume gives a reviewer a useful picture of senior litigation support. More detail about how you handle productions and trial preparation could help distinguish your work from similar resumes.
model_output.first_impression: Commercial and employment litigation are easy to spot, as are Relativity and trial preparation. The production size is worth keeping because it shows the scale of work you manage.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Track court deadlines in the firm's docketing system" doesn't explain how you handle competing deadlines, leaving the responsibility difficult to assess.
model_output.summary: Supporting four partners on commercial contract and employment matters anchors your current senior paralegal role. Your work spans discovery, document production, court deadlines, and trial preparation, with earlier personal injury experience. The resume shows senior-level litigation support, but it gives less detail about the steps you take on complex assignments. That makes it harder to understand how you handle the work beyond the listed deliverables.
strengths: Productions of up to 250,000 pages in Relativity show the scale of a responsibility you manage.
Supporting two jury trials in 2025 gives the trial-preparation work a recent, concrete setting.
State and federal e-filing experience adds useful context to your earlier personal injury work.
gaps: The discovery bullet names the documents you draft but not an example of the issues or materials you use to prepare them.
The trial bullet doesn't distinguish what you prepared before trial from any support you provided during proceedings.
CaseMap and Westlaw appear in Skills without examples of how you used them, so their place in your case work is unclear.
